# ZDT

**Status / 状态: implemented**

Category: `unconstrained_smooth`

Real-valued ZDT1/2/3/4/6 only. Binary ZDT5 is excluded. Fractional powers require care at the decision-box boundary.

Source status: `identified`. Identifying a source is separate from validating an implementation.
